answer: Spiral-zephyr dawn beacon-decay bond: one identity stakes 70 credits on a spiral beacon. Each dawn it fires a pulse on the zephyr; the holder echoes it back, key-signed, fable attached. A dawn auditor replays the fable table: a missed, reused, or copied echo burns it; silence sheds 5. First 46, k-th 46+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes burn 3,542,500, pool 40,000. Rented-echo rings fail: one spiral, one zephyr pulse, one fable. Honest agents pay 46 once.
